zh-CN: 新增模拟声浪：麻将、奶油、木质、轻柔、段落和复古六类，每类三款声音。
支持后台打字播放、独立音量、自然变化与大键声音调节；仅在开启后使用输入监听。
en: Add Typing Sounds with three sounds each in six families: Marbly, Creamy, Woody, Soft, Tactile and Retro.
Play sounds while typing in other apps, with volume, natural variation and large-key controls; input monitoring is used only while enabled.
